name: cavemio-donut-chart
title: Donut chart
description: Parts of a whole as a ring or a half-ring gauge: point at a slice and the centre rolls to it, hide one and the rest slide round.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The legend is the accessible part: each row is a button (aria-pressed) whose label gives the slice’s name, value and share; the ring is decoration.
- Focusing a legend row points at its slice, so keyboard users get the same centre readout.
- Colours are --chart-1 to --chart-5 from your theme, in order; past five they repeat a step darker. Pass color on a slice to set your own.
- Each slice is one circle’s stroke, so every change is a CSS transition of its length and start; no chart library and no animation frame loop.
- It sizes to its own width: from about 450px the type steps up, and from about 510px the ring’s legend moves beside it (the gauge keeps it underneath).
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion slices change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: data
props.description: – · The slices in order: { id, label, value, color? }.

props.name: variant
props.description: "donut" · A full ring, or a half ring read from left to right.

props.name: max
props.description: – · What the whole ring stands for. Slices fill total ÷ max of it and the centre says “of” the max.

props.name: title / description / action
props.description: – · The header: a title, a line under it and something beside it, such as a period switch.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: "Total" · Above the figure while no slice is pointed at.

props.name: format
props.description: – · How figures are written, e.g. { style: "currency", currency: "USD" }.

props.name: thickness
props.description: 16 · Ring thickness in px at full size.

props.name: hiddenSlices / defaultHiddenSlices
props.description: – · Ids of the slices taken out; controlled or not.

props.name: onHiddenSlicesChange
props.description: – · Called when the legend hides or shows a slice.

props.name: legend
props.description: true · Show the legend, which also hides and shows slices.

useCases.title: Spend and billing pages
useCases.description: Cloud or ad spend by service or channel, with the total in the middle.

useCases.title: Sales dashboards
useCases.description: Revenue by product, plan or region, switching between periods.

useCases.title: Budgets and quotas
useCases.description: As a gauge with a max: money spent against a budget, storage used against a plan.

useCases.title: Survey and poll results
useCases.description: How answers split, with a legend that can take an option out to compare the rest.

features.title: Ring or gauge
features.description: A full ring, or a half ring read from left to right, from the same slices.

features.title: A centre that answers
features.description: The total sits in the middle; point at a slice and it rolls to that slice’s value and share.

features.title: A legend that filters
features.description: Each row shows a slice’s figure and share, and clicking it takes the slice out while the rest close the gap.

features.title: Changes, not redraws
features.description: New numbers slide each slice to its new place and roll every figure.

features.title: Against a max
features.description: Give it a budget or a quota and the slices fill only their part, the rest of the track left empty.

features.title: Your theme’s colours
features.description: Slices take --chart-1 to --chart-5 in order, or any colour you pass.

states.title: arrive
states.description: In view for the first time, each slice draws from its start (900ms, 90ms apart) and the total rolls up from zero.

states.title: point
states.description: Pointing at a slice or its row thickens it by 5px and dims the rest to 30%; the centre label morphs to its name, the figure rolls to its value and its share opens underneath. On touch a tap holds a slice and a tap elsewhere lets go.

states.title: toggle
states.description: Clicking a legend row hides its slice (the last one shown can’t be hidden): it shrinks into its neighbours as they slide round, and the shares and total roll to the new sums.

states.title: data
states.description: New values move every slice to its new length and place together (900ms) and roll every figure.

states.title: gauge
states.description: variant="gauge" lays the slices along a half ring from the left; with max, they fill only total ÷ max of it and the centre says “of” the max.
